metadata.description: Personal Claude Code tooling shared across projects: skills, subagents, hooks, LSP, monitors.

plugins.name: pre-push-review
plugins.description: Fix-and-verify review that fixes code smells, security, scalability, and performance issues before any git push.

plugins.name: daily
plugins.description: Daily rhythm skills: morning (kickoff recap) and evening (wind-down with tomorrow's top 3, wellbeing and social suggestions).

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Blocking safety hooks: destructive Fly.io/prod-DB ops, force-push to main, AI attribution in commits, secrets/PII in staged and pushed diffs.

plugins.name: coach
plugins.description: Non-blocking coaching hooks: per-stack nudges on edit (Python/TS/Swift, FEATURE_COLS sync, no em-dashes in UI text), session banner, failure hints, uncommitted reminder.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Task lifecycle: new-task (BA authoring + contradiction gate + Gherkin), requirements, plan-task, task-review, debug, qa skills + architect, debugger and requirements-analyst subagents.

plugins.name: reviewers
plugins.description: Per-stack reviewer subagents: Python/FastAPI, web (Vite/React/TS), SwiftUI, and ML pipeline (LORO gate, FEATURE_COLS sync, leakage).

plugins.name: fly-ops
plugins.description: Fly.io ops runbooks: deploy (with release_command gotcha), fly-logs, incident triage.

plugins.name: lsp
plugins.description: Language servers: Python (pyright), TypeScript, Swift. Binaries installed per machine, see SETUP.md.

plugins.name: monitors
plugins.description: Background monitors: live TypeScript build errors and local dev-server [ERROR]/[WARN], idle-safe outside matching repos.

plugins.name: mcp-catalog
plugins.description: MCP server catalog (example): GitHub, Playwright, Postgres. Copy .mcp.json.example into a project and fill credentials.

plugins.name: seo
plugins.description: seo-strategist subagent + seo-audit skill: keyword research through technical, programmatic, and LLM SEO (AI Overviews, ChatGPT/Perplexity citability).

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: researcher subagent: delegable multi-source research with claim verification and cited briefs.

plugins.name: content
plugins.description: content-writer subagent + social-post skill: one idea into platform-native posts for LinkedIn, Threads, X, Instagram; EN/UK, owner's voice.

plugins.name: reports
plugins.description: report-builder subagent + weekly-report skill: business reports, decks, and consulting deliverables with charts.

plugins.name: biz
plugins.description: Business growth subagents: aso-optimizer (App Store), growth-analyst (funnel/conversion), outreach-writer (partnership and consulting pitches).
